why: The line in the square turns 45 degrees each step: \ then | then /, so next it is flat (horizontal). The arrow turns 135 degrees anticlockwise each step: up-left, down, up-right, so next it points left. Option 2 has a flat line and a left arrow. Option 1 has the flat line but the arrow points right.
trick: When a line and an arrow both turn, find the turning step of each one separately.
